test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fact_clustered (id UInt64, s String, v UInt64, INDEX idx_s s TYPE text(tokenizer = 'array')) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE fact_spread (id UInt64, s String, v UInt64, INDEX idx_s s TYPE text(tokenizer = 'array')) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dim (s String, n UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY s
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO fact_clustered SELECT number, concat('k', toString(intDiv(number, 200))), number FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO fact_spread SELECT number, concat('k', toString(cityHash64(number) % 100000)), number FROM numbers(10000000)
INSERT INTO dim SELECT concat('k', toString(number)), number FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT sum(f.v) FROM fact_clustered AS f INNER JOIN dim AS d ON f.s = d.s WHERE d.n < 100
SELECT sum(f.v) FROM fact_clustered AS f INNER JOIN dim AS d ON f.s = d.s WHERE d.n < 4000
SELECT sum(f.v) FROM fact_spread AS f INNER JOIN dim AS d ON f.s = d.s WHERE d.n < 100
SELECT sum(f.v) FROM fact_spread AS f INNER JOIN dim AS d ON f.s = d.s WHERE d.n < 4000
